title: Personal Checking Charges and Rebates for Cash Machine and Foreign Use
content:
A withdrawal or balance inquiry at a cash machine that is not the bank's own, inside the United States, carries the Personal Checking tier's out-of-network charge. A withdrawal at a cash machine outside the United States carries the tier's international charge instead. A debit card purchase or cash machine withdrawal made outside the United States or in a foreign currency carries the tier's foreign transaction charge, expressed as a percent of the United States dollar amount of the item.

| Tier | Out-of-network cash machine charge, domestic (USD) | International cash machine charge (USD) | Foreign transaction charge (percent of the item amount) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Access Checking | 2.50 | 5.00 | 3.00 |
| Student Checking | 0.00 | 5.00 | 3.00 |
| Everyday Checking | 3.00 | 5.00 | 3.00 |
| Interest Checking | 3.00 | 5.00 | 3.00 |
| Premier Checking | 0.00 | 0.00 | 1.00 |
| Private Client Checking | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |

Surcharges added by the operator of a cash machine that is not the bank's own are rebated within the statement cycle up to the tier's count and cumulative cap.

| Tier | Operator surcharges rebated per statement cycle | Cumulative rebate cap per statement cycle (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| Access Checking | 0 | 0.00 |
| Student Checking | 4 | 12.00 |
| Everyday Checking | 0 | 0.00 |
| Interest Checking | 2 | 10.00 |
| Premier Checking | 6 | 30.00 |
| Private Client Checking | unlimited | no cap |

A charge or percentage of 0.00 means no charge arises on that tier. Where the rebate count reads unlimited and the cap reads no cap, the tier sets no ceiling of either kind.

**Illustration of the two ceilings (hypothetical).** On Interest Checking the tier rebates 2 surcharges per cycle up to 10.00 in that cycle. Two surcharges of 3.00 each are rebated in full at 6.00, and a third surcharge in the same cycle is outside the count. Two surcharges of 6.00 each reach the count at 12.00, which stands above the cumulative cap of 10.00, so the cap is what binds.
